# Mining Dimension Repolished
### Mining Dimension Repolished adds a dimension just for mining resources!

**How to get to the mining dimension:**

- Craft Dimensional Bricks with 2 Blackstone & 2 Amethyst
- Build a Portal Frame in the same shape as the nether portal.
- Craft a Flint and Amethyst
- Ignite the Portal with the Flint & Amethyst
